title: Grateful Dead Live at Temple University on 1970-05-16

ai_review.summary: Close‑stage audience tape with decent instrument presence but thin vocals and a noticeable manager‑induced cut, making the listening experience uneven.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the band fairly close to the stage, giving the instruments good presence while the vocal mix suffers from being too low. A cutting incident—attributed to the GD manager—creates an audible gap that further hampers enjoyment. Overall it’s a serviceable glimpse of a 1970 college gig but not a polished listening document.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews note some positive aspects (instrument presence) but repeatedly criticize the vocal balance and a noticeable cut, with limited discussion of musical performance; overall rating falls in the lower‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Close to stage gives good instrument presence; vocals are low and PA is under‑represented. A cut caused by the manager creates a noticeable gap, reducing overall clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific song commentary; reviewers treat it as a typical 1970 college gig that was professional but unremarkable.
